name: SQLite Key-Value Store
summary: Resilient key-value store with TTL expiration backed by native Node.js SQLite (Node 22.5+)
description:
## SQLite KV Store

A zero-dependency, transactional key-value storage engine backed by native `node:sqlite`. Features automatic TTL eviction, namespaced partitioning, and JSON document queries.

> [!NOTE]
> Requires Node.js >= 22.5.0 with native `node:sqlite` enabled.

### Features
- Native SQLite backend using `node:sqlite` (experimental in Node 22)
- Auto-pruning TTL expiration
- Namespaced keys
- Bulk atomic batch operations
- Zero external runtime dependencies
